translations.b0358: Part 12  Strengthening Efforts to Ensure and Improve People's Wellbeing and Making Solid Progress Toward Common Prosperity for All
translations.b0359: Efforts will be made to ensure and improve people's wellbeing through high-quality development and to do everything within the country's capacity; the basic public service system will be improved; more equitable, inclusive, targeted and effective social policies will be implemented; inclusive, basic and safety-net initiatives to improve people's wellbeing will be strengthened; the pressing difficulties and problems of greatest concern to the people will be resolved; channels for social mobility will be kept open; and people's quality of life will be improved.
translations.b0360: Chapter 41  Promoting High-Quality and Full Employment
translations.b0361: The employment-first strategy will be implemented in depth; the expansion of employment capacity will be combined with the improvement of employment quality; mechanisms for promoting employment will be improved; and an employment-friendly development model will be established.
translations.b0363: High-quality and full employment will be made a priority goal of economic and social development, and mechanisms for assessing the employment impact of major policies, major projects and the layout of major productive forces will be improved. Coordination between industry and employment will be strengthened; an initiative to stabilize jobs, expand employment and improve quality will be implemented; policy support will be continuously strengthened for enterprises in sectors that absorb a large amount of employment, such as foreign trade, construction, accommodation and catering; the potential of the service sector and emerging fields to absorb employment will be fully tapped; and the sound development of flexible employment and new forms of employment will be promoted. Employment for key groups such as college graduates, rural migrant workers and veterans will be stabilized and expanded. Employment assistance for groups in difficulty will be strengthened; unemployed people will be helped to find new jobs; and at least one member of every zero-employment family will be ensured employment. Support for starting businesses will be increased, and the role of entrepreneurship in creating jobs will be enhanced. The impact on employment of changes in the external environment and the development of new technologies such as artificial intelligence will be addressed comprehensively. An evaluation system for high-quality and full employment will be established.
translations.b0364: Section 2  Carrying Out Vocational Skills Training on a Large Scale
translations.b0365: Mechanisms for matching the supply of and demand for human resources will be improved; the system of lifelong vocational skills training will be improved; and efforts will be focused on resolving structural employment problems. With market-based training playing the lead role and independent training by industries and enterprises as the mainstay, the strengths of schools and social training institutions will be fully leveraged to expand the supply of high-quality training. Employment subsidy funds, unemployment insurance funds and other resources will be coordinated and used to support vocational skills training, and enterprises will be guided to fully withdraw and use employee education funds in accordance with regulations. Training subsidies will be delivered directly to enterprises and trainees, and a system under which unemployed people in key groups can apply for training subsidies will be introduced. The classification of occupations, occupational standards and the skilled talent evaluation system will be improved; the “new eight-level worker” vocational skill level system will be implemented in depth; and a national qualifications framework will be developed. China will host a successful World Skills Competition.
translations.b0366: Section 3  Strengthening Employment Services and the Protection of Workers' Rights and Interests
translations.b0367: The employment support and public service systems will be improved, and a fair and orderly employment environment will be created. The labor standards system and the mechanisms for consultation and coordination of labor relations will be improved; the system for protecting the rights and interests of people in flexible employment and new forms of employment will be improved; platform enterprises will be urged to formulate fair labor rules and employ workers in compliance with laws and regulations; and harmonious labor relations will be fostered. The digital and intelligent transformation of personnel file services for workers on the move will be accelerated. Guidance on career choices and hiring practices will be strengthened. The legal system for labor and employment will be improved; the effectiveness of mediation and arbitration of labor relations disputes will be enhanced; the labor security supervision system will be improved; enterprises will be urged to implement working-hour rules in accordance with the law; and employment discrimination, wage arrears, non-payment of social insurance contributions, illegal layoffs and other such problems will be effectively addressed. The system for statistics, monitoring and risk early warning on employment and unemployment will be improved, and mechanisms for preventing and defusing the risk of large-scale unemployment will be improved.
translations.b0368: Chapter 42  Improving the Income Distribution System
translations.b0369: The principle of distribution according to work will remain predominant while multiple forms of distribution coexist; the institutional system for coordinated and complementary primary distribution, redistribution and tertiary distribution will be improved; the share of residents' income in national income distribution will be increased; and the share of labor remuneration in primary distribution will be raised.
translations.b0370: Section 1  Optimizing the Pattern of Primary Distribution
translations.b0371: The primary distribution mechanism under which all factors are evaluated by the market for their contributions and remunerated according to those contributions will be improved, so that those who work more earn more, those with higher skills earn more and those who innovate earn more. Mechanisms for determining wages, ensuring reasonable wage growth and guaranteeing wage payment will be improved; the system of collective wage bargaining will be implemented; the minimum wage adjustment mechanism will be improved; and macro guidance for enterprise wage distribution will be strengthened. Reform of the wage determination mechanism of state-owned enterprises will be deepened; the wage, allowance and subsidy systems of government agencies and public institutions will be improved; and wage distribution will be tilted more toward the grassroots and areas with difficult conditions. The system of enterprise compensation surveys and information disclosure will be improved. Property income of urban and rural residents will be increased through multiple channels; the dividend incentive and restraint mechanisms of listed companies will be improved; financial products and services that meet residents' wealth management needs will be enriched; and the share of farmers in the value-added benefits of land will be increased. Distribution policies oriented toward increasing the value of knowledge will be strengthened; more qualified state-owned enterprises will be allowed to carry out various forms of medium- and long-term incentives for researchers oriented toward innovation and creativity; and the building of a skills-oriented remuneration system will be accelerated.
translations.b0372: Section 2  Strengthening the Regulation of Income Distribution
translations.b0373: Redistribution through taxation, social security and transfer payments will be strengthened to improve the pattern of income distribution. Tax regulation will be made stronger and more targeted; the system of tax and fee services and oversight for natural persons will be improved; and a unified tax on labor income will be applied. The role of special additional deductions will be fully leveraged, and individual income tax deductions will be increased. Mechanisms for tax regulation of capital gains will be explored and improved, and tax oversight of high-income earners will be strengthened. The mutual assistance and risk-pooling functions of social security will be strengthened, and gaps in financing and benefit protection between systems and between regions will be gradually narrowed. The functional positioning of transfer payments will be optimized, and the role of general transfer payments in narrowing regional fiscal gaps will be strengthened. The disaster relief and assistance system will be improved. The role of tertiary distribution will be better leveraged; the development of public welfare and charity will be promoted and regulated; and effective forms of charity will be explored.
translations.b0374: Section 3  Steadily Expanding the Middle-Income Group
translations.b0375: A plan to increase the incomes of urban and rural residents will be formulated and implemented; the incomes of low-income groups will be effectively increased; the proportion of the middle-income group will be raised; and the formation of an olive-shaped distribution pattern will be promoted. Income-increasing policies will be implemented in a targeted way for key groups: the job-matching rate of college graduates will be improved; technical workers will be helped to achieve both higher pay and higher skills; the system for guaranteeing wage payment to rural migrant workers will be fully implemented; multiple measures will be taken to help small and medium-sized business owners and self-employed individuals operate steadily; and high-quality farmers and rural leaders in getting rich will be actively cultivated to enhance their ability to increase incomes and prosper. The order of income distribution and the mechanism for wealth accumulation will be regulated; hardworking, innovative and lawful ways of getting rich will be supported; those who become well-off first will be encouraged to help others and promote common prosperity; excessively high incomes will be reasonably regulated; and illegal incomes will be banned.
translations.b0376: Chapter 43  Improving the Social Security System
translations.b0377: With the focus on strengthening protection for key groups and enhancing the sustainability of the system, a multi-tiered social security system that covers all citizens, coordinates urban and rural areas, is fair and unified, safe and well-regulated, and sustainable will be improved.
translations.b0378: Section 1  Steadily Raising the Level of Social Security
translations.b0379: An initiative for high-quality social insurance participation will be implemented, and social insurance coverage will be continuously expanded. The development of a multi-tiered, multi-pillar old-age insurance system will be accelerated; the mechanism for determining and adjusting benefits will be improved; the basic pension for urban and rural residents will be gradually raised; adjustments to the basic pensions of retirees will be tilted toward groups receiving lower benefits; coverage of enterprise annuities will be expanded; the individual pension policy will be improved; and commercial old-age insurance will be vigorously developed. The multi-tiered medical security system will be improved; settlement of medical expenses incurred outside one's home locality will be improved; and the supplementary protection role of commercial medical insurance will be fully leveraged. Participation rates of people in flexible employment, rural migrant workers and people in new forms of employment will be increased; contribution bases will be reasonably determined; and the contribution responsibilities of employers and platform enterprises will be clearly defined. Coverage of social insurance such as unemployment and work-related injury insurance will be expanded, and a system of occupational injury protection will be established and improved. Policies for the transfer and continuation of social insurance relationships will be improved, and the efficiency of transferring and continuing old-age insurance relationships will be increased. The unified national public service platform for social insurance and the related administrative services will be optimized.
translations.b0380: Section 2  Enhancing the Sustainability of the Social Insurance System
translations.b0381: The actuarial system for social insurance will be improved, and mechanisms for the long-term pooling of social security funds, their coordinated allocation, value preservation and appreciation, and safety oversight will be refined. The strategic reserve fund for social security will be strengthened and improved, and state capital will continue to be transferred to replenish social security funds. Incentives for participation and contribution will be strengthened; qualified collective economic organizations and others will be encouraged to subsidize urban and rural residents' insurance contributions; and the fiscal subsidy standard for basic medical insurance for urban and rural residents will be reasonably raised. The national pooling system for basic old-age insurance will be improved and implemented; provincial-level pooling of basic medical insurance will be basically achieved; and provincial-level pooling of unemployment and work-related injury insurance will be consolidated. Policies for social security fund investment and the oversight system will be improved, information disclosure and performance evaluation will be strengthened, and oversight of medical insurance funds will be strengthened.
translations.b0382: Section 3  Improving the Social Assistance System
translations.b0383: A tiered, categorized and urban-rural coordinated social assistance system will be improved. The basic livelihood assistance system and the specialized assistance system will be improved; social assistance standards will be adjusted dynamically; and assistance will be strengthened for families just above the subsistence allowance line and for families facing difficulties due to rigid expenditures. Service-type social assistance will be actively developed, and coordination among various social assistance policies will be strengthened. The temporary assistance system will be improved, and assistance will be provided directly by the place where an emergency or difficulty occurs. The mechanism for identifying and monitoring assistance recipients will be improved; the assistance system will be effectively linked with other policies; and recipients' internal drive to overcome difficulties will be stimulated.
translations.b0384: Chapter 44  Promoting High-Quality Development of Real Estate
translations.b0385: The building of a new model for real estate development will be accelerated; the housing system featuring supply by multiple entities, support through multiple channels and the simultaneous development of renting and purchasing will be improved; and the goal of ensuring that all people have a place to live will be achieved at a higher level.
translations.b0386: Section 1  Improving the Housing Security System
translations.b0387: The supply of government-subsidized housing will be optimized; housing security for low-income urban families with housing difficulties will be strengthened; the basic housing needs of wage earners with housing difficulties and modest incomes will be better met; and the temporary housing difficulties of new urban residents, young people and other groups will be gradually resolved. Whole-process management of government-subsidized housing will be strengthened, and management mechanisms for application, waiting lists, allocation for rent or sale, use and exit will be improved. Ways to orderly convert and coordinate the use of rental-type and sale-type government-subsidized housing will be explored. Reform of the housing provident fund system will be deepened; its scope of use will be expanded; and people in flexible employment will be supported in participating in the housing provident fund system.
translations.b0388: Section 2  Promoting the Steady and Healthy Development of the Real Estate Market
translations.b0389: The basic systems for commercial housing development, financing and sales will be improved. The project company system and the lead bank financing system for real estate development will be implemented; reasonable real estate financing needs will be met; and sales of completed housing will be advanced steadily and in an orderly manner. The scale and layout of real estate land supply will be reasonably arranged, and land supply will be coordinated with the existing housing stock and population changes. Urban governments will be fully granted autonomy in regulating the real estate market. Classified handling of land that has been supplied but not developed and of projects under construction will be promoted, and the revitalization and use of unsold commercial housing and idle commercial and office properties will be advanced. The supply of housing for improved living conditions will be increased in light of each city's conditions. Safe, comfortable, green and smart “good homes” will be built, and a housing quality improvement project and an initiative to improve property management service quality will be implemented. The housing rental market will be developed in a well-regulated manner, and market-oriented and professional rental enterprises will be cultivated. A system for whole-life-cycle safety management of housing will be established.
translations.b0390: Chapter 45  Steadily Advancing Equal Access to Basic Public Services
translations.b0391: The balance and accessibility of basic public services will be enhanced, and more notable substantive progress will be made in ensuring equal access to basic public services.
translations.b0392: Section 1  Establishing the Institutional Framework for Equal Access to Basic Public Services
translations.b0393: Plans and policies for equal access to basic public services will be formulated and implemented; equal access to basic public services for the resident population will be achieved more quickly; the balanced development of urban and rural basic public services within county areas will be advanced in an orderly manner; and gaps in basic public service resources between regions will be gradually narrowed. Guided by equal opportunities and broadly comparable outcomes, a system of evaluation standards for equal access to basic public services will be established; evaluation standards will be refined by field; and evaluation of the degree to which equal access is achieved will be explored. Focusing on such areas as childcare, education, employment, medical care, elderly care, housing and assistance for vulnerable groups, the scope and content of basic public services will be improved; services urgently needed by the people will be incorporated in due course; national standards will be adjusted dynamically; and standards will be better coordinated across regions. More public services will be channeled down to the grassroots, extended to rural areas and tilted toward remote areas and people in difficult circumstances. Coordination of basic public service provision within counties will be strengthened, and long-term mechanisms for funding guarantees will be improved.
translations.b0394: Section 2  Comprehensively Providing Basic Public Services at the Place of Residence
translations.b0395: Mechanisms for allocating public resources in line with the resident population will be improved. In cities with large concentrated inflows of population, tiered provision of scarce public services based mainly on years of employment and residence will be implemented in a well-regulated manner, and the number of tiers and differences in services will be gradually reduced. The policy of allowing holders of residence permits to participate in basic medical insurance for urban and rural residents will be implemented. The non-registered resident population will gradually be included in child welfare, social assistance and other services at their place of residence. Reform of public institutions will be comprehensively deepened; the structure and layout of public institutions in the public service sector will be optimized; and the fiscal transfer payment allocation mechanism, which takes full account of factors such as the number of resident service recipients and service costs, will be consolidated and improved.
translations.b0396: Chapter 46  Safeguarding the Development Rights and Interests of All Groups
translations.b0397: The care service system will be improved; a social environment that effectively safeguards the development rights and interests of women, minors, young people, people with disabilities and other groups will be created; and services and support for veterans will be improved.
translations.b0398: Section 1  Promoting Gender Equality and the All-Round Development of Women
translations.b0399: The basic state policy of gender equality will be upheld, and women will be guaranteed equal participation in economic and social development, equal exercise of democratic rights and equal enjoyment of the fruits of reform and development in accordance with the law. The maternal and child health service system will be improved; comprehensive prevention and treatment of breast and cervical cancer will be strengthened; and free vaccination against human papillomavirus (HPV), as part of the national immunization program, will be fully implemented for girls of the appropriate age. Women's equal rights to education and employment will be safeguarded; rural women's membership rights in collective economic organizations and their rights to land contract management will be safeguarded in accordance with the law; and women will be supported in participating in grassroots governance. Domestic violence will be continuously prevented and stopped, and illegal and criminal acts infringing on women's rights will be severely punished.
translations.b0400: Section 2  Strengthening Care and Protection for Minors
translations.b0401: Priority will be given to children's development, and children's rights to survival, development, protection and participation will be effectively guaranteed. Early screening and intervention for children's myopia, overweight and obesity, autism and other conditions will be advanced. The level of children's medical and health care services will be improved, and the variety of pediatric medicines will be enriched. Care services for children in difficulty will be strengthened; classified assistance for migrant children and left-behind children will be advanced; and the level of welfare protection will be effectively raised. Services for early childhood development will be improved. A plan of action for the prevention and control of childhood injuries will be formulated and implemented; efforts to prevent and address juvenile delinquency will be strengthened; and school bullying will be effectively prevented and addressed. Online protection for minors will be strengthened, and the space and platforms for online education of young people will be expanded. Child-friendly development will be advanced, and a social environment that cares for the next generation will be created.
translations.b0403: Plans and policies to promote youth development will be improved, and favorable conditions will be created for young people to grow and succeed and to make their mark. Ideological and political guidance for young people and the shaping of their values will be strengthened; youth programs for making contributions in such fields as scientific and technological innovation and rural revitalization in the new era will be carried out in depth; and young people will be supported in becoming pioneers and the main force in all fields and aspects of work. Young people will be helped to resolve practical difficulties in study, work, innovation and entrepreneurship, marriage and childbearing, housing security, social integration and other areas. Mechanisms for young people to express their interests and for responding to their demands will be improved, and channels for young people to participate in social governance in an orderly manner will be expanded.
translations.b0404: Section 4  Improving Services and Support for Veterans
translations.b0405: Reform of the management of veterans will be deepened, and the organizational management, work operation, and policy and regulation systems will be improved. The mechanism for determining and adjusting preferential care benefits will be improved; the coordinated management of preferential care items will be strengthened; and the assistance, aid and legal service systems for veterans will be improved. Management reform of hospitals and homes of glory for entitled groups will be deepened, and the medical and convalescent care system for entitled groups will be improved. High-quality resettlement and employment of veterans will be advanced; resettlement measures will be improved; and policy support and service guidance will be strengthened. The system of honors, incentives, commendations and awards for veterans will be improved. Efforts to build model cities and counties of mutual support between the military and the people will be strengthened and improved. The spirit of martyrs will be vigorously promoted.
translations.b0406: Section 5  Enhancing the Protection and Development Capacity of People with Disabilities
translations.b0407: The social security and care service systems for people with disabilities will be improved, and the all-round development of programs for people with disabilities will be promoted. Safety-net protection will be strengthened for people with severe disabilities, people with multiple disabilities, and families with more than one member with disabilities; the systems of living allowances for people with disabilities in difficulty and nursing subsidies for people with severe disabilities, as well as the mechanism for dynamically adjusting subsidy standards, will be improved; rehabilitation assistance for children with disabilities will be strengthened; and the subsidy system for assistive devices for people with disabilities will be improved. Community and family support for people with disabilities will be improved; care for people with severe disabilities will be strengthened; and community-based rehabilitation for mental disorders will be developed. Employment assistance for people with disabilities will be strengthened, and mechanisms for promoting proportional employment, concentrated employment and self-employment will be improved. Cultural and sports activities for people with disabilities will be developed. The use of science and technology to assist people with disabilities will be advanced in depth, and barrier-free environments will be developed in public facilities, information exchange and social services.
